name: Shinkon-san ~Sweet Sweet Honeymoon~
source:
Soutaro and Haru are cousins. Even though they are men, they were forced to marry and started living together. Soutaro loves Haru very much, but Haru just followed his grandfather's will. Soutaro gradually gets irritated by Haru's coldness. Will they be able to get along together...?

[Edited from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081030015023/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1008641]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
宗太郎与春是一对表兄弟。尽管两人都是男性，他们仍被迫结婚并开始共同生活。宗太郎深爱着春，春却只是遵从祖父的意愿。面对春的冷淡，宗太郎渐渐感到烦躁。他们能够和睦相处吗…？

[编辑自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081030015023/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1008641]ErogeShop[/url]]
